title: Twenty-one years
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-one. The corn. The aggregator wants the Sunday vertical. Wood eats corn horizontally.

panels.composition: The garage. Corn. A laptop open: an email from the aggregator with a mock-up of 'The Carry' cut into a vertical strip. WOOD eating corn. BARNABY II.

image.prompt: a man eating corn at a drafting table beside a laptop showing a comic page chopped into a vertical scroll, a three-legged dog, clean ink

panels.composition: The mock-up. The drift log tier cropped to a square. No gulls.

image.prompt: close-up of a laptop screen showing a watercolor tier cropped to a square with its sky and gulls cut off

panels.composition: Wood, to the dog, corn in hand.

balloons.text: Twenty-one years drawing wide. They want tall. The bay isn't tall. The bay's the widest thing I know.

image.prompt: a man holding a tray of corn and speaking to a dog while looking at a laptop, tired

panels.composition: Alone at the long surface — drawn wide, wider than the grid, the panel itself stretched. Corn. Dog. Laptop closed.

image.prompt: an unusually wide panel of a man with his back turned at a long drafting table with a closed laptop, a tray of corn and a dog, no words
image.notes: Draw this panel wider than the others. The strip's answer to vertical.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: 'The bay's the widest thing I know.' The last panel drawn wide on purpose.
